program.name: Upper Plyo
program.subject: Plyometrics
program.blurb: Explosive upper body: clap push-ups, explosive push-ups and sprawls, then push strength.
program.about: Explosive upper-body power: clap push-ups, explosive push-ups and sprawls, with long rests so each rep is fast. Push strength follows, then abs. Two days alternate the moves. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations. Knees down on the clap push-ups is fine while the power builds.
